highlights.title: U.N. Updates: Netanyahu Lashes Out at Critics and Underscores Threats to Israel
highlights.summary: In a combative speech, the prime minister defended Israeli military action across the Middle East, and attacked Mayor Zohran Mamdani of New York. Dozens of delegates walked out of the hall as he took the podium.

highlights.title: Live: Pope heads to France on first state visit in 18 years
highlights.summary: Pope Leo XIV flies to France on Friday for the Vatican's first state visit to the European nation in 18 years, with artificial intelligence and young believers near the top of his agenda. President Emmanuel Macron and his wife Brigitte will be on the tarmac to greet the 71-year-old pope.

highlights.title: Nepal’s catastrophic floods were ‘warning to the world,’ PM Shah tells UN
highlights.summary: Nepal’s Prime Minister Balendra Shah said on Thursday that last month’s catastrophic floods were a “warning to the world” of growing climate risks in the Himalayas.
